faqs.question: What does the Fungal Culture and Identification by MALDITOF (Vitek MS) – Stool test measure?
faqs.answer: This test measures the presence of fungal infections in the stool and identifies the specific type of fungus causing the infection.

faqs.question: Why is the Fungal Culture and Identification by MALDITOF (Vitek MS) – Stool test done?
faqs.answer: • This test is mainly done to diagnose fungal infections and guide appropriate antifungal treatment. • It also helps assess the effectiveness of ongoing treatment and monitor the progress of the infection.

faqs.question: When is the Fungal Culture and Identification by MALDITOF (Vitek MS) – Stool test recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: Your doctor may recommend this test if you have symptoms such as persistent diarrhea, abdominal pain, or unexplained weight loss, which could be indicative of a fungal infection. The test is suitable for individuals who are suspected of having a fungal infection or need to assess the effectiveness of antifungal treatment.

faqs.question: What if the results of the Fungal Culture and Identification by MALDITOF (Vitek MS) – Stool test are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results, i.e., results indicating the presence of specific fungi in the stool may point towards a fungal infection.

faqs.question: What to expect during the Fungal Culture and Identification by MALDITOF (Vitek MS) – Stool test?
faqs.answer: During this test, you will be asked to provide a stool sample in a sterile container. The sample will be sent to the laboratory, where it will be cultured on a special medium to promote fungal growth.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the Fungal Culture and Identification by MALDITOF (Vitek MS) – Stool test?
faqs.answer: • Collect a 5gm stool sample in a sterile, leak-proof container. • Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with the Fungal Culture and Identification by MALDITOF (Vitek MS) – Stool test?
faqs.answer: Other tests that may be ordered alongside this test include: • Blood tests: To assess general markers of infection and inflammation. • Imaging studies: Such as X-rays or CT scans to evaluate the extent of the infection. • Antifungal susceptibility testing: Determines which antifungal drugs are most effective against the identified fungus.

faqs.question: What is the Fungal Culture and Identification by MALDITOF (Vitek MS) – Stool test also known as?
faqs.answer: Stool Fungal Culture and Identification by MALDI-TOF Mass Spectrometry, Stool Fungal Culture

faqs.question: What is a fungal infection?
faqs.answer: A fungal infection is caused by the overgrowth of certain types of fungi. These infections can affect various parts of the body, such as the skin, nails, or internal organs. Common types of fungal infections include candidiasis, ringworm, and aspergillosis.
